title: The herds
summary: The camel family's history as small herds you follow across the globe: from North America, camels north to Asia, llamas south to the Andes.

whatsNew.title: The herds
whatsNew.what: Small herds of the camel family moving with the date, from North America over Beringia and south to the Andes. Come close to one and the date slows.
